args.title: Bird Pie Recipe
args.content:
Savory Bird Pie (Chicken Pot Pie)

Ingredients:
- 2 lbs chicken breast or thighs, cubed
- 2 cups chicken broth
- 1 cup heavy cream
- 3 medium carrots, diced
- 2 celery stalks, diced
- 1 medium onion, diced
- 2 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 cup frozen peas
- 3 medium potatoes, cubed
- 1/3 cup all-purpose flour
- 4 tbsp butter
- 1 tsp thyme
- 1 tsp rosemary
- Salt and pepper to taste
- 2 pie crusts (store-bought or homemade)

Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C)
2. In a large pot, melt butter over medium heat
3. Cook chicken until browned, remove and set aside
4. In the same pot, sauté onion, carrots, celery, and garlic until soft (5-7 min)
5. Sprinkle flour over vegetables, stir for 1 minute
6. Gradually add chicken broth and cream, stirring constantly
7. Add potatoes, thyme, rosemary, salt, and pepper
8. Simmer until potatoes are tender and sauce thickens (10-15 min)
9. Add chicken and peas, stir to combine
10. Roll out bottom crust and place in 9-inch pie dish
11. Pour filling into crust
12. Cover with top crust, seal edges, and cut vents
13. Brush top with egg wash (1 beaten egg) for golden color
14. Bake 30-35 minutes until crust is golden brown
15. Let cool 10 minutes before serving

Serves: 6-8 people

When Azul returns in spring, he finds orphaned sparrows who lost their parents and don't know how to migrate. Corvus returns to see what Azul has accomplished and observes that "a teacher is only truly measured by what his students pass on."

By autumn, Azul and the sparrows migrate together, with young Pip leading the way using the North Star while Azul follows behind - transformed from the lost bird into the guide who shows others how to find their way.
